items.title: How AI Agents Are Reshaping IT Incident Management - with Mary M Goode of U.S. Bank
items.summary: As enterprises ship changes faster across tightly interconnected systems, IT operations teams are struggling to stay ahead of alert volume while keeping services stable. In this episode, Mary M Goode, Vice President IT Service Management Operations at U.S. Bank, explores how AI capabilities such as event correlation, anomaly detection, and change risk intelligence can shift IT operations from reactive to proactive — and why they depend on well-managed data and documentation. She also outlines practical first steps for leaders, from improving change visibility and service mapping to standardizing operational data and building a culture of proactive ownership.
